# v2.8 data fixtures

Generated by `tests/fixtures/make-v28.js`. Do not edit by hand: run the script again.
The numbers on this page are also in `v28-facts.json` (for tests) and `v28-meta.json`.

- Built on 2026-11-22 (UTC) for "today" = **Sat, Nov 21, 2026** in America/Los_Angeles.
- The fixtures' "now" is **17:40 that day** (`meta.now` = 1795311600000 ms, 2026-11-22T01:40:00.000Z). In UTC that is already the next day, on purpose.
- Tests give `meta.now` and `meta.tz` to `lib.newPhone`, so the fixture's today stays today whenever the test runs. With the real clock the data simply looks older every day.
- Each `.json` is the exact text v2.8 kept in `localStorage["overload.state.v1"]` (one line, no trailing newline). Loaded into v2.8 at `meta.now`, the app writes back the same bytes (`roundTrip` in the facts).

The typed-in custom foods of the main fixture are three ("Mom's lasagna", "Sourdough, corner bakery", "Protein cookie, double chocolate"; the last was found by an unknown barcode) plus one listed product whose label was corrected ("Quest Bar, Cookies & Cream": `src: custom` under the product's own `u…` id). A fourth typed-in food ("Office birthday cake") was logged twice and then deleted: its entries point at a food id that no longer exists.

`v28-state-active.json` is the main fixture plus the workout in progress: the same finished workouts, food, weigh-ins and nights. The prescriptions of the exercises already finished in that workout have moved on, and their entries carry `next` and `prevPresc`.

## Files

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `v28-state.json`, `v28-state-active.json`, `v28-state-small.json` | The fixtures. |
| `v28-meta.json` | `common` (time zone, today, now, the app's default settings, the weekly schedule) and per fixture the `overload.backup` value. `lib.loadFixture(name).meta` merges the two. |
| `v28-facts.json` | Per fixture: `counts` (from the data) and what the v2.8 screens showed (`today`, `foodDays`, `addSheet`, `exercises`, `history`, `chart`, `settings`, `active`). `lib.loadFixture(name).facts`. |
| `v28-story.json` | Everything notable the simulated person did, by date (`log`), and every confirm / prompt the app showed with the answer given (`dialogs`). |
| `make-v28.js`, `sim-page.js` | The generator: Node side (the plan, the fake connector, snapshots, this page) and in-page side (the clock and the simulated person). |

## Using a fixture in a test

```js
const lib = require('../lib');                                   // tests/lib.js
const fx = lib.loadFixture('v28-state');                         // { text, state, meta, facts }
const server = await lib.startServer(lib.REPO, 8317);
const browser = await lib.launch();
const phone = await lib.newPhone(browser, { now: fx.meta.now, timezoneId: fx.meta.tz });
await lib.seedV28(phone.context, fx);                             // before the app's scripts run, once per context
const page = await lib.openApp(phone.context, server.url + '/index.html');
await lib.openTab(page, 'history');
// ... then compare the screen, or lib.readStorage(page, 'overload.state.v1'), with fx.state and fx.facts
phone.assertClean();
```

Regenerate with `node tests/fixtures/make-v28.js` (about two minutes; `--today=YYYY-MM-DD` pins the last day, `--only=small` or `--only=main` builds a part). The same day and seed give the same bytes. Check with `node tests/smoke-v28.js`.

Built on another day the story is the same (70 workouts, 110 food days, the same events the same number of days before the last day), but some training numbers move a little: the first time v2.8 draws Today it creates prescriptions for the default program's exercises of that weekday, with the default goal of 10 reps, before the rep range is changed to 8-12, and which exercises those are depends on the weekday of the first day. Built on a Monday, "this week" holds only the last day, so History's weekly review has no workouts in it.

## Beside the state

v2.8 keeps two more small keys, which `lib.seedV28` also sets: `overload.theme` (`dark` here) and `overload.backup` (`{"since":1785587400000,"lastExport":1794546665637}`: first start and last export, in ms). The fixtures have no `overload.sync.v1` (cloud sync never signed in) and no `overload.conn.*`.

The theme is forced to dark in the main fixtures. For light screens seed with `lib.seedV28(context, fx, { theme: 'light' })`, or `{ theme: 'system' }` and a `colorScheme`.
